mapper.select: select p.pno, pa.ano, p.price, p.pqty, p.pdelete, p.pfilename, p.pregdate, p.pmoddate, p.ptitle_ko, p.ptitle_en, p.ptitle_ja, p.ptitle_zh, p.pcontent_ko, p.pcontent_en, p.pcontent_ja, p.pcontent_zh, p.pcategory_ko, p.pcategory_en, p.pcategory_ja, p.pcategory_zh from (select pno from tbl_product where pdelete = 0 order by pno desc limit #{skip}, #{size} ) as limited_p left join tbl_product_allergy as pa on limited_p.pno = pa.pno left join tbl_product as p on limited_p.pno = p.pno order by p.pno desc, pa.ano

SELECT p.pno, p.price, p.pqty, p.pdelete, p.pfilename, p.pregdate, p.pmoddate, p.ptitle_ko, p.ptitle_en, p.ptitle_ja, p.ptitle_zh, p.pcontent_ko, p.pcontent_en, p.pcontent_ja, p.pcontent_zh, p.pcategory_ko, p.pcategory_en, p.pcategory_ja, p.pcategory_zh FROM tbl_product p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pa.pno, ua.ano FROM tbl_product_allergy pa LEFT JOIN tbl_user_allergy ua ON pa.ano = ua.ano WHERE ua.uno = #{uno} GROUP BY pa.pno ) pua ON p.pno = pua.pno WHERE p.pno > 0 AND pua.pno IS NULL AND p.pdelete = 0 order by p.pno desc limit #{pageRequest.skip}, #{pageRequest.size}
select count(pno) from tbl_product where pno > 0 and pdelete = false

select p.pno, p.ptitle_ko, p.pfilename, p.pcontent_ko, p.price, p.ptitle_en, p.pcontent_en, p.ptitle_ja, p.pcontent_ja, p.ptitle_zh, p.pcontent_zh from tbl_product_popular pp left join tbl_product p on pp.pno = p.pno where p.pdelete = 0 order by ppno desc limit #{skip}, #{size}
